hints.title: Tokenize and Measure
hints.text: Split the sentence into word tokens and precompute word lengths.

hints.title: Row Partition Exploration
hints.text: Iterate through possible breakpoints for the current row, ensuring length does not exceed the line limit.

hints.title: Last Line Exemption
hints.text: The last row contributes zero penalty to the accumulated total cost.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N^2) state transitions for word prefixes
variables: N: number of words in sentence
complexity.notes: The last row incurs zero penalty cost.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedily packing as many words as possible into each row can lead to suboptimal overall cost.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D memoization caches optimal suffixes to prevent exponential recursion.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should clearly identify that the last row cost must be zero.
